sloka: एवमेतन्नरश्रेष्ठ यथा वदसि लक्ष्मण ।परितोषश्च मे वीर मम कार्यानुशासने ।। ७.५२.१८ ॥
transliteration: evametannaraśreṣṭha yathā vadasi lakṣmaṇa ।paritoṣaśca me vīra mama kāryānuśāsane ।। 7.52.18 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, Lakshmana, this is indeed as you say, and I am greatly satisfied, O hero, with your counsel regarding my duty.
